title: taxonomy.updated payload
description: Emitted by MAM when an operator-managed vocabulary entry changes. Consumed by Search, WebSocket. The `kind` enum is Tier 0 (the SET of vocabularies is code-known); the terms themselves are data — see docs/architecture/configuration-and-reference-data.md.

replacedById.description: For action `merged`: the surviving term old references redirect to.

configVersion.description: Snapshot version after this change; consumers may revalidate their cached reference snapshot.
